title: Dual of a finite constant module sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a commutative noetherian ring. Let $M$ be a finitely generated $\Lambda$-module. Write $M_X$ for its constant coefficient sheaf on the small étale site of $X$ [def-constructible-constant], and $\Lambda_X$ for the monoidal unit. Then $\mathcal Hom_\Lambda(M_X,\Lambda_X)\cong (\operatorname{Hom}_\Lambda(M,\Lambda))_X$ as sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules.

proof.text: A finite module over the noetherian coefficient ring has a finite presentation Λᵐ → Λⁿ → M → 0. Apply the exact constant sheaf functor to obtain a presentation of M_X by finite free coefficient sheaves. This includes the zero module by taking a zero presentation.

Internal Hom into the unit turns this cokernel presentation into a kernel: maps from any sheaf T into the internal Hom are maps M_X ⊗ T → Λ_X, and tensoring preserves the presentation cokernel. Duals of the finite free coefficient sheaves are finite free, by the tensor-Hom adjunction, and the resulting map is the transpose of the presenting matrix.

Constant sheafification preserves kernels. The module kernel of the transposed matrix is Hom_Λ(M,Λ), since a map Λⁿ → Λ vanishes on the relations exactly when it factors uniquely through M. Uniqueness of the kernel isomorphism gives the asserted constant sheaf comparison. This does not use projectivity of M.

theorem nonempty_constantModuleDualIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) {Λ : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) [Module.Finite Λ M] :
    Nonempty ((ihom ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)).obj
      (𝟙_ _) ≅ (constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of Λ (M →ₗ[Λ] Λ)))
